eras.note: Assumed decennial map preceding the current one; this project's data begins in 2016, so its earlier years are outside the checked range.

The map drawn after the 2020 census and used for this chamber's first election of the decade, then replaced before the current one took effect. Its start year follows from the chamber having voted before stateLegMapInfo's firstCycle; the enacting instrument is not recorded here.

eras.label: current
eras.note: Redraws 2 Senate districts (DeSoto County and Hattiesburg/Forrest County areas) from the same NAACP v. State Board of Election Commissioners ruling; the DeSoto sub-plan required a second court-ordered revision (May 7, 2025) after an initial version was rejected. Special elections under this map were held November 2025, flipping 1 Senate seat and ending the GOP supermajority. Not on the 2026 ballot (odd-year cycle, next 2027). Same Callais-remand caveat as the House map. Veto override is 2/3; the 3/5 threshold in Mississippi applies only to revenue/tax bills, not vetoes.
